snippet.title: 스페인 스테이크 탐방기 : ‘늙은 소’ 하나만을 위해 전세계 미식가들이 모이는 시골 깡촌 (feat. 비밀이야)
snippet.description:
🔽오늘 영상을 촬영한 장소🔽
오프닝 장소 산세바스티안 해변 https://maps.app.goo.gl/jxSnSNsc11GnTM6C9 
기울어진 그릴을 개발한 70년 전통 카사 훌리안 https://maps.app.goo.gl/fYcee43u7hxJmQiw5 
수백마리의 소를 직접 기르는 팜투테이블 스테이크 엘 카프리초 https://maps.app.goo.gl/pmcC52otLxjr9pudA 
영상 촬영 이후 '월드 101 베스트 스테이크 랭킹'이 2026년 버전으로 새로 발표 되었습니다.
카사 훌리안은 7위→6위로 상승했고
엘 카프리초는 6위→10위로 하락했습니다.

https://lounge.kurly.com/link/GipF-mJfX

[Shio Ramen Ingredients List]

Recipe for 8 Servings

[Salt Seasoning Sauce]

Dried Scallops 25g https://link.coupang.com/a/eawX35

Kelp 10g https://link.coupang.com/a/eatGpc

Water 100g

Sake 100g

Sugar 10g https://link.coupang.com/a/eatIRT

Salt 30g (Mixing various salts is better) https://link.coupang.com/a/eauPJl

⇨ Add water to extract a final 200g seasoning

(Version tailored to Korean saltiness)

[Chashu & Seasoned Eggs]

Pork belly 1kg

Dark soy sauce 150g https://link.coupang.com/a/eaw0uP

Sake 60g

Mirin 60g https://link.coupang.com/a/eatU3O

Eggs as much as desired

[Kelp Broth]

Kelp 40g https://link.coupang.com/a/eatGpc

Shiitake mushrooms 6 https://link.coupang.com/a/eatYa8

⇨ Extract 2 liters

[Ramen Broth]

Kelp 2 liters of broth

1 kg of pork backbones

1 kg of chicken bones

1 stalk of green onion https://link.coupang.com/a/eat0T0

1 onion https://link.coupang.com/a/eat2mW

8 cloves of garlic https://link.coupang.com/a/eat3uj

Ginger (a finger's length) https://link.coupang.com/a/eat5Qs

2 tablespoons of vinegar https://link.coupang.com/a/eat7SN

100 g of sake

3.5 liters of water

200 g of minced chicken breast

⇨ Extract 4 liters

Since the broth is very rich based on 4 liters,

if you are looking for a lighter broth among famous Hakodate ramen places,

diluting it with 5~6 liters is sufficient.

[Combination]

Based on 1 serving (1 bowl)

2 tablespoons of salt seasoning

300~350 g of ramen broth

Ramen noodles 100~120g product https://link.coupang.com/a/eaulR6

Char Siu as much as you want

Menma (bamboo shoots) as much as you want https://link.coupang.com/a/eaugyF

A little green onion https://link.coupang.com/a/eat0T0

(Add other ingredients like spinach, Naruto fish cake, etc. at your discretion)

Since the salt seasoning and ramen broth are made separately,

you can freely adjust the saltiness.

Because the saltiness can vary quite a bit depending on the kelp, scallops, and salt used,

you will eventually have to try a bowl first,

add more broth if it's too salty, and add more seasoning if it's too bland.

3 tablespoons red pepper seeds

10-20 cloves garlic
3 green onions

1 onion
1/2 pear

60 dried red peppers

1/4 pear

500ml beef bone broth (can substitute with the water left over from boiling the tail)

3 tablespoons of anchovy sauce
3 tablespoons of dashida

Soy sauce:vinegar:water = 1:1:1
Add chopped vegetables to taste.

[Ingredients for the Yurin-gi Chicken]
2kg frozen chicken meat

[Beard]
500ml water
1 tablespoon salt https://link.coupang.com/a/cxlBmn
2 tablespoons vinegar https://link.coupang.com/a/cxlyos
2 teaspoons pepper https://link.coupang.com/a/cxlBvU

[Batter]
350g 70% Potatoes https://link.coupang.com/a/cxlyI4
150g 30% Corn https://link.coupang.com/a/cxlySA
Approximately 200ml Cooking Oil https://link.coupang.com/a/cxlyY2
Mix until mayonnaise-like.
(If you don't want to waste the oil, you can add a little water.)

[Sauce]
